title: Try pottery with a Santa Fe artist

location.label: Paseo Pottery, Santa Fe, New Mexico

description: Enjoy roughly two hours of beginner wheel throwing or hand-building, focused on experimentation rather than a perfect object.
teaser: Make something new with a local Santa Fe artist.
whyItMightDelightYou: Two hours to play with clay and enjoy making something by hand.
goodToKnow: Ask about winter workshop dates and a comfortable seated beginner session.
